## Join the group

We are always happy to hear from motivated students interested in quantitative biodiversity analysis, animal movement or conservation.

- **TFM (MSc thesis)**: we offer projects every year within the UCM Master's programmes in Conservation Biology and Zoology, and co-supervise theses with colleagues at other universities. Projects are usually linked to our active projects and datasets (ringing, eBird, camera traps, acoustic recorders). Write to us in spring for the following academic year.
- **PhD**: we support applications to competitive fellowships (FPU, FPI, Comunidad de Madrid, Marie Skłodowska-Curie). Get in touch early with a short description of your interests and a CV.
- **Postdocs and visitors**: we host visiting researchers and students and support fellowship applications (Juan de la Cierva, Ramón y Cajal, MSCA). If our research aligns with yours, let's talk.

Contact: [gfandos@ucm.es](mailto:gfandos@ucm.es)
